  SELECT a.ask_id, e.entry_id, e.reel_id, e.first_frame AS entry_first, e.reel_first AS source_first,
         MAX(a.first_frame, e.first_frame) AS mix_first,
         MIN(a.end_frame, e.end_frame) AS mix_end
  FROM listening_ask AS a
  JOIN assembly_entry AS e ON e.mix_id = a.mix_id
)
SELECT ask_id, entry_id, reel_id, mix_first, mix_end,
       source_first + (mix_first - entry_first) AS reel_first,
       source_first + (mix_end - entry_first) AS reel_end
FROM spans
WHERE mix_first < mix_end
ORDER BY ask_id, mix_first, entry_id",
  "decision-trace-common-quote-witnesses": "WITH RECURSIVE ancestry(edition, doc) AS (
  SELECT edition, doc FROM quotation WHERE edition IN ('Amber', 'Blue')
  UNION
  SELECT r.edition, a.copied_from
  FROM ancestry AS r
  JOIN account AS a ON a.doc = r.doc
  WHERE a.copied_from IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT a.doc AS witness
FROM account AS a
JOIN ancestry AS r ON r.doc = a.doc
WHERE a.copied_from IS NULL
GROUP BY a.doc
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.edition) = 2
ORDER BY witness COLLATE BINARY ASC",
  "decision-trace-shared-equipment-premium-splits": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT p.posting_id, p.premium_cents, m.workshop_bps, m.source_id, m.primary_text,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.posting_id ORDER BY m.effective_day DESC, m.revision_no DESC) AS priority
  FROM equipment_posting AS p
  JOIN operating_memo AS m ON m.gear_code = p.gear_code AND m.effective_day <= p.service_day
), allocated AS (
  SELECT posting_id, premium_cents, source_id, primary_text,
         (premium_cents / 10000) * workshop_bps + ((premium_cents % 10000) * workshop_bps) / 10000 AS workshop_cents
  FROM ranked
  WHERE priority = 1
)
SELECT posting_id, workshop_cents, premium_cents - workshop_cents AS stores_cents, source_id, primary_text
FROM allocated
ORDER BY posting_id COLLATE BINARY ASC",
  "decision-triangulate-forward-sight-consensus": "WITH offsets AS (
  SELECT k.stake_id, k.east_m - s.base_e AS de, k.north_m - s.base_n AS dn, s.step_e, s.step_n
  FROM search_stake AS k CROSS JOIN field_sight AS s
), counts AS (
  SELECT stake_id, COUNT(*) AS sight_count
  FROM offsets
  WHERE de * step_n = dn * step_e
    AND ((de > 0 AND step_e > 0) OR (de < 0 AND step_e < 0)
      OR (dn > 0 AND step_n > 0) OR (dn < 0 AND step_n < 0))
  GROUP BY stake_id
)
SELECT stake_id, sight_count
FROM counts
WHERE sight_count >= 2 AND sight_count = (SELECT MAX(sight_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY stake_id COLLATE BINARY ASC"
